column2: Slaughterfish, dry-foot. Twenty paces north of here the water is full of them. More lie ten paces off to the south-west. They take my catch off the line. I do not forgive it. Wade slow and do not splash.
Giant mudcrabs sit on the shore about thirty paces south-south-west. They are slow, but I leave them alone, and so should you.
The walled part of Lilmoth? Walk east-north-east from here, about a hundred paces. You will meet the walls. I think those walls keep out the wrong people.
Hereguard Plantation is west-south-west, a little over a hundred paces. Ask for Salith when you get there. She sells me my bait. The plantation pays its hands too little, but Salith is fair.
Wild leeks grow on the bank, east-south-east of here, about a hundred paces. Keep to the bank when you go. The lily pads are mine. I do not want anyone splashing about on them.

Hm. I do not tell this to everyone. There is a giant crab called Old Salty in the shallows to the south-south-west, about ninety paces from here. He is old. He is not to be bothered. Leave him be, dry-foot.
I am Uleesh. I fish the shallows below the walls and sell my catch inside. Rent in there costs more than fish pay, so I live out here. I have fished this water twenty years and I know it.
